scenes.a: Staring at a heavy financial ledger tonight, fearful of hidden costs, hear God's promise.
The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
Lord, we bring our daily work, our decisions, and our accounts into Your steady care.
You know the exact measure of our daily bread and the honest desires of our hearts.
Deliver us from wealth gained through endless anxiety, grief, or compromised truth.
Establish the work of our hands with Your quiet peace, providing all that we truly need.
Let Your divine favor rest upon our home, filling every quiet corner with lasting rest.
Subscribe to The Provision Table to walk in God's daily provision.
